name: 30071 · Norcross, GA
findings: ZIP 30071 (Norcross) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30071 (Norcross) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30071 (Norcross) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
